description: This class provides utility functions for handling product pricing in an e-commerce system, including price retrieval, final price calculations considering attributes and discounts, and formatting amounts with currency symbols.

classes.name: ProductPriceUtils
classes.description: Utility class for product pricing calculations and formatting.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the base price of a product from its availability options.

methods.name: getFinalProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final product price considering product and attribute-specific attributes.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price for a product without considering attributes, including discounts.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount as a raw string suitable for admin input, e.g., '1,299.99'.

methods.name: getStoreFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount as a string with local currency formatting for display in the storefront.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount with currency for a given locale and currency object.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount as a string with store's currency for admin purposes.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats an amount with store currency and specified locale.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Parses a string input to BigDecimal, considering currency formatting.

methods.name: getOrderProductTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates total order product price based on quantity and unit price.

methods.name: hasDiscount
methods.description: Checks if a ProductPrice has a current applicable discount.
